title_sq: Vile me pishine ne shitje, Park Houses!
description_sq:
Rezidenca Park Houses eshte nje kompleks modern banimi qe ofron qetesi, hapesira te gjelbra dhe cilesi te larte ndertimi. E projektuar per nje stil jetese komod dhe bashkekohor, ajo kombinon arkitekturen elegante me funksionalitetin, duke krijuar nje ambient ideal per familje dhe individe qe kerkojne rehati dhe siguri.
Vila ofron nje mundesi te shkelqyer banimi , duke ofruar ndriçim natyral, organizim praktik te hapesires dhe akses te lehte ne sherbimet kryesore të zones.
Vila eshte organizuar ne 4 kate, ofron një oborr privat me pishine, duke garantuar rehati dhe stil jetese cilesor.
Gjithashtu disponon dhe 2 poste parkimi.

title_en: Villa with pool for sale, Park Houses!
description_en: The Park Houses residence is a modern residential complex that offers tranquility, green spaces and high quality construction. Designed for a comfortable and contemporary lifestyle, it combines elegant architecture with functionality, creating an ideal environment for families and individuals seeking comfort and security. The villa offers an excellent residential opportunity, offering natural lighting, practical organization of space and easy access to the main services of the area.
